gloss: to care for; to treat with kindness; to show compassion

definitions.gloss: to care for; to treat with kindness; to show compassion
definitions.explanation: To treat someone gently and with compassion, especially someone who is sick, elderly, weak, or in need of care.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}の{母|はは}をいたわる。
examples.english: I care for my sick mother.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}をいたわってください。
examples.english: Please take care of your health.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{部下|ぶか}をいたわる{上司|じょうし}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known as a boss who treats his subordinates with kindness.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). Takes を to mark the person or thing being cared for.

KANJI:
Can be written as {労|いたわ}る, though hiragana is more common.

USAGE:
いたわる implies gentle, compassionate treatment, often directed toward those who are vulnerable, tired, or in need. It suggests warmth and consideration rather than mere assistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{体|からだ}をいたわる (to take care of one's body)
・{心|こころ}をいたわる (to comfort/soothe)
・{老人|ろうじん}をいたわる (to care for the elderly)
・いたわりの{気持|きも}ち (feelings of compassion)

RELATED NOUN:
いたわり - compassion, kindness, tender care

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{気遣|きづか}う - to be considerate/concerned about (more about attention)
・{世話|せわ}をする - to look after (more practical care)
・{大切|たいせつ}にする - to value/treasure (broader meaning)
